scientific_integrity: The claim uses exact four-dimensional generator coordinates, Euclidean volume and a proved continuous piecewise-polynomial phase diagram; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only the indicated two-parameter transverse scale-and-tilt subfamily is classified; other generator deformations and non-product higher-dimensional lifts remain outside the claim. Full material inspection of one broad Rayleigh manuscript was unavailable.
title: A sharp transverse instability tongue for four-dimensional zonotope volume
